violated_contract: A simple (non-plural, non-select) translated message must render every runtime value its English source renders. gen-l10n accepts a translation that omits an English placeholder, so the locale silently hides the ETA, app name, count or error the English string shows.
canonical_prevention: scripts/l10n.py check rejects a simple translation whose placeholder set is missing any English placeholder (plural/select messages, which locales legitimately restructure, stay exempt) and runs as a manifest check on every ARB change; hermetic fixtures keep a rejected and an exempt case.
